g.text: Pilot · pair B: CPU Spark + Polars GPU

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Each point is one measured action from a fresh concurrent wave; no averaging, confidence intervals or tests. Pilot has one repetition at SF30 and is not
pooled with expansion. Common queries only. Pair B complex excludes Q13 and window: its CPU-only measurements remain unpaired diagnostics. Pairs have
different competitors and do not rank the two GPU engines. Action timers exclude setup and rendezvous waits.
